notes:
What's new

- HTML files open in a safe reader view: headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, code and links, with scripts and styles discarded and never run. Links are collected at the end.
- JPEG XL is recognised. With a JPEG XL codec installed it decodes like any other image; without one the app names the extension to install instead of showing a wrong or blank picture.
- Undecodable images no longer show the Windows file-type icon as if it were a preview. WebP, HEIF and AVIF explain a missing codec, and damaged images say so.
- Screen readers now get a real UI Automation document (file name, format, page position, shortcut help) and hear page changes. Tab moves a visible focus ring through the toolbar, Enter presses, Esc leaves.
- Public CI now runs a generated format matrix, and a signature gate can stop a release from publishing unsigned.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.27 - 1G + accessibility + CI gating. HTML gets a dependency-free reader view (Markdown block mapping, script/style/iframe discarded, links listed). JPEG XL support through WIC with a codec-missing state; WebP/HEIF/AVIF get the same honest state; the image viewer no longer accepts shell file-type icons as thumbnails. Added a UI Automation document provider (name/value/help, ValuePattern, notifications) plus Tab/Enter focus navigation with a painted ring (WM_APP+286/287/288/289 diagnostics). tools/ci_probe.py generates 21 fixtures (83 checks) and runs in CI; tests/accessibility_test.py adds 17 checks through UIAutomationClient. publish.ps1 -RequireSignature and the WINPREVIEW_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE variable gate unsigned releases; signing supports PFX, thumbprint or subject with timestamp fallback.
